Hi Kaiya,

Thanks for applying to the Platform Product role — I'm Karthik on the recruiting team. We'd like to schedule a brief 30-minute phone screen to learn more about your experience and share more about the role and team. Quick logistics question before I propose times: which timezone are you in? Also, do you prefer Google Meet or Zoom?

We typically run a short initial screen that can include one hiring manager; depending on availability we sometimes rotate interviewers. If you can share your timezone and a couple of windows that work in the next week, I will convert and send a calendar invite. To make scheduling easier, here are a few options in PST (I can convert to your timezone once you confirm):

- Tue 10 Nov — 8:00 PM PST (30 min)
- Wed 11 Nov — 8:00 PM PST (30 min)
- Fri 13 Nov — 7:30 PM PST (30 min)

If none of those work, tell me two blocks (morning/afternoon/evening) that are best and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Lauren from Talent Ops to help with calendar invites.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Technical Recruiter
